creator: Alexander Terp
description: Seen 2026-10-21 23:35 in a full ./dev on main (5878e4bf) on the Mac mini, load 11.4 and about 6 GB in swap while two other projects' agent rounds ran: lifecycle::a_spawned_daemon_answers_its_first_request_within_budget measured the fastest of five daemon starts at 27.2 ms (all: 62.2, 32.6, 27.2, 33.5, 33.0) against the 25 ms budget. It passed 3 of 3 alone straight after at load 7.9. The test's doc says twenty starts measured 3.9 ms at a load average of 30, so CPU load alone does not explain it; memory pressure and swap may. That evening, four of five full gates each failed on a different timing-sensitive test (this, a_2jPCdMlpU, a_2lzok4LKg, and a linked maker-watch test fixed in 60264451). Measure a daemon start under memory pressure, and decide whether the budget should account for it or the gate should say when the machine is swapping, as it already says the load.
title: 🎲 The daemon start budget failed under load with swap in use
